answer.rationale: switch_primary_vendor best satisfies finance's 18% cost cut since the incumbent has refused to reprice this cycle. Memory c2 (moving primary supply to a low-cost vendor last year cut unit cost sharply, onboarding was quick, invoicing stayed accurate) directly supports that switching historically delivered sharp savings with low operational friction here. Because the contract expires in 14 days and cannot be deferred without auto-renewal risk, defer_decision is unsafe. Renewing or re-negotiating with the incumbent are foreclosed by their stated refusal to reopen price this cycle, and while add_second_source (c3) reduces single-point-of-failure risk it does not by itself meet the 18% spend-cut mandate in one cycle. Verify c2 before committing to confirm the prior vendor-switch savings magnitude and onboarding smoothness still apply to the current component set.
